name: Reading progress bar
summary: A thin coral bar along the top of the screen that fills as the reader scrolls.

name: Key takeaways
summary: The post's main points as a ticked list, with a four-item stat strip.

name: Contents list
summary: Numbered jump links to each section of the post.

name: Route finder quiz
summary: Three quick questions that suggest which funding routes to discuss first.

name: Funding stack builder
summary: Sliders that build a funding stack against the total needed, with a live gap check.

name: Repayment calculator
summary: Estimates monthly repayments and total cost for a fixed-rate loan, with an illustrative-only note.

name: Match-up grid
summary: Pairs what a business has with the funding types that may suit it.

name: Interactive checklist
summary: A tick-off document checklist with a progress meter and a CTA at the end.

name: CTA strip
summary: A navy mid-article strip with a heading, one line and a button.

name: Callouts
summary: Warning and tip notes that highlight a key point next to the text.

name: FAQ accordion
summary: Expandable questions with matching FAQ schema for Google rich results.

name: Sticky bottom bar
summary: A dismissible CTA bar that slides up once the reader is 30% through the post.
